name: apple-icloud
description: Read your iCloud Calendar, Reminders and Contacts, and create, edit and delete calendar events and reminders, using an Apple app-specific password. Includes a skill that walks you through forwarding iCloud Mail to Gmail, Outlook or another mailbox your agent already reads. Contacts are read-only and there are no mail tools.

APPLE_ID.title: Apple ID email
APPLE_ID.description: The email address of your Apple ID, used to sign in to iCloud Calendar, Reminders and Contacts.

APPLE_APP_PASSWORD.title: App-specific password
APPLE_APP_PASSWORD.description: An app-specific password created at https://account.apple.com (Sign-In and Security > App-Specific Passwords). Never use your normal Apple ID password. You can revoke it at any time.
